findings.risk: Using an outdated version of Elasticsearch may expose the domain to known vulnerabilities
findings.remediation: Update elasticsearch_version to a supported and secure version

findings.risk: Allows all Elasticsearch actions from any principal, which could lead to unauthorized access and data breaches
findings.remediation: Restrict the principals to specific AWS accounts or IAM roles and limit actions to only those necessary

findings.risk: The policy allows all actions on the Elasticsearch domain from any principal, which could lead to unauthorized access and data breaches
findings.remediation: Update the access_policies to restrict actions and principals to only those necessary
